clauses.2.1: Annual limit. The maximum we pay in any policy year is USD 50,000 for all covered benefits combined.
clauses.3.1: Deductible. You pay the first USD 300 of covered outpatient and inpatient costs in each policy year before we pay.
clauses.4.1: Inpatient care. After the deductible we pay 100% of covered inpatient costs. Room and board is limited to USD 200 per night.
clauses.4.2: Outpatient care. After the deductible we pay 80% of covered outpatient costs, up to USD 2,000 per policy year.
clauses.6.1: Dental. Only emergency dental treatment after an accident or acute pain is covered, up to USD 500 per policy year. Routine cleaning, fillings and orthodontics are not covered.
clauses.6.2: Waiting period for dental. Dental benefits begin 90 days after your cover start date. This waiting period does not apply to dental treatment needed because of an accident.
clauses.8.1: Exclusions. We do not pay for conditions that existed before your cover start date, for injuries from extreme sports, or for cosmetic treatment.
clauses.9.1: Claim deadline. You must submit a claim within 60 days of the treatment date.
